name: io.github.ktcod/x402-json-repair-mcp
description: Pay-per-call MCP server: deterministic JSON repair + JSON Schema validation/coercion, settled in USDC on Base via x402. Fix malformed LLM/tool JSON (trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, Python literals, code fences, truncation) and optionally validate/coerce against a JSON Schema.
